options.description: On this machine your typed command is found and it works as today; on a copy without your log, auto-approve stays off until you type it there. Turning it off always counts.
options.label: "On" needs my words (Recommended)

options.description: A recorded "on" counts everywhere, even though the agent could write one itself.
options.label: Record alone is enough

payload.question: Given that only your private log can prove you typed "auto-approve on": should turning it on count only where that log has your command, while turning it off counts from the record alone?
